data.title: Super Number Ordering!

challenges.instruction: Can you put these three numbers in order from smallest to biggest?
Great job! Now let's try ordering four numbers from smallest to biggest.
You are doing wonderful! Let's arrange these numbers in order from biggest to smallest.
Fantastic! Can you order these five numbers from smallest to biggest?
Here is the final challenge! Arrange these five numbers from biggest to smallest.

data.description: Students practice ordering sets of numbers in ascending and descending order to build strong number sense.
